market_summary: All three assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, BTCUSD) are exhibiting compressed momentum or lack of volume confirmation during the late London session. Gold and Bitcoin remain structurally bearish below their respective Value Areas and downward-sloping VWAP/EMA50 baselines, but are consolidating right above session low supports with low relative volume (no yellow RVOL spikes). EURUSD is trapped in neutral chop directly at VWAP inside its Value Area. With no confirmed breakouts or clean liquidity sweep triggers across the board, capital preservation dictates HOLD on all pairs.

signals.rationale: Price trades below VAL (3957.75) and below POC (3978.28), confirming strong session value displacement to the downside. CVD is BEARISH (-5.02) with negative slope (-1.18), agreeing with the downtrend. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading well below descending VWAP (3968.15) and EMA50 (3961.10). Candles are hovering near the lower ATR band (3932.65) without fresh RVOL confirmation (last 1.099, no yellow bars in 47 bars). Although bearish pressure persists, price is consolidating above Session Low support at 3924.30 without a clean entry trigger or liquidity sweep, warranting a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10793 to VAH 1.10983) and below POC (1.10943), which promotes mean-reverting chop rather than trend expansion. CVD is NEUTRAL (-321) despite a sharp negative slope, showing lack of sustained directional aggression. During LONDON_SESSION, price is chopping directly across VWAP (1.10866), EMA20 (1.10891), and EMA50 (1.10892). ATR bands are neutral with price positioned mid-channel. RVOL sits at 1.184 with no yellow spike breakout. Sitting between Prev Low (1.10824) and EMA cluster with no directional clarity mandates a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering around VWAP and EMA20/50 cluster
signals.level_event: acceptance around Prev Low 1.10824 and VWAP

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73295.04) and POC (73518.45), maintaining deep bearish session displacement. CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) with negative slope (-0.01), aligning with seller control. In LONDON_SESSION, candles are tracking below both descending VWAP (73484.26) and EMA50 (73408.67). The price tested into the lower ATR band (72721.93) following a breakdown through Prev Low (73097.30). However, RVOL is only 1.247 with zero yellow spikes, and the forming bar is hovering right near Session Low support at 72639.70 without a clear breakdown expansion or sweep reversal. Prudent action is to HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.volatility: expanding downward at lower ATR envelope
signals.level_event: retest of broken Prev Low 73097.30 holding below
